content: {"summary":"A proxy pod remained Pending after its egress node was cordoned on 2026‑09‑16. Anti‑affinity allows only one proxy per egress node, so the replacement cannot be scheduled while the other node holds the sole running instance. Raising the local request‑per‑second limit on the surviving pod is a possible lever, but it would create a gap with no proxy if the missing pod is not restored. Anti-affinity allows one per egress node."}],"next_checks":["Check current CPX_LOCAL_RPS value in the ConfigMap","Determine if the cordoned egress node can be uncordoned or repaired","Assess impact of temporarily raising CPX_LOCAL_RPS on the surviving pod","Consider manually deleting the Pending pod to force rescheduling on the available node"]}
